Requirement You are installing or already carry a Frame-slot cyber-augment whose purpose is recoil or stance stabilization (GM's call on borderline cases).

You had the frame brace tuned for one job: keep the barrel level. A Frame-slot augment installed for this purpose costs 1 less Drift than its listed value (minimum 0) — the rest of what it does is unchanged, you've just stripped out everything that wasn't in service of the shot.

cinderfall.incomplete: flagged in Open Questions since I did not locate the augment card schema/field for "Drift" within this pass's time budget to confirm total absence versus just unfamiliarity with where it lives. This effect is defined entirely in terms of a Cinderfall-homebrew subsystem with zero Foundry schema footprint (the Gun Failure Table/Failure Range, hazardous ground, time-in-sights, Trick Iron charge bank, or Drift/augment-slot cost). Confirmed via the full rule-element type listing (pf2e-source/src/module/rules/rule-element/, 40 files): no RollTable-manipulation, no persistent-terrain-hazard, and no arbitrary stacking-counter rule element type exists to hook any of these to.
